longTitle.officialTitle: To amend the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to reauthorize the National Estuary Program, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Protect and Restore America’s Estuaries Act”.

section.heading: MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE.
section.content: Section 320(a)(2)(B) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1330(a)(2)(B)) is amended by striking “and Peconic Bay, New York” and inserting “Peconic Bay, New York; Casco Bay, Maine; Tampa Bay, Florida; Coastal Bend, Texas; San Juan Bay, Puerto Rico; Tillamook Bay, Oregon; Piscataqua Region, New Hampshire; Barnegat Bay, New Jersey; Maryland Coastal Bays, Maryland; Charlotte Harbor, Florida; Mobile Bay, Alabama; Morro Bay, California; and Lower Columbia River, Oregon and Washington”.

section.heading: PURPOSES OF CONFERENCE.
section.chapeau: Section 320(b)(4) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1330(b)(4)) is amended—

paragraph.content:
by striking “management plan that recommends” and inserting “management plan that—
“(A) recommends ” ; and

by adding at the end the following:
“(B) addresses the effects of recurring extreme weather events on the estuary, including the identification and assessment of vulnerabilities in the estuary and the development and implementation of adaptation strategies; and
“(C) increases public education and awareness of the ecological health and water quality conditions of the estuary; ” .

section.heading: MEMBERS OF CONFERENCE.
section.content: Section 320(c)(5) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1330(c)(5)) is amended by inserting “nonprofit organizations,” after “educational institutions,”.

section.heading: GRANTS.
section.chapeau: Section 320(g)(4)(C) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1330(g)(4)(C)) is amended—

subparagraph.content: by striking “coastal areas” and inserting “the estuaries selected by the Administrator under subsection (a)(2), or that relate to the coastal resiliency of such estuaries”;

paragraph.content: in clause (viii), as so redesignated, by inserting “, extreme weather,” after “sea level rise”.

section.heading: AUTHORIZATION OF APPROPRIATIONS.
section.content: Section 320(i)(1) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1330(i)(1)) is amended by inserting “, and $50,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2022 through 2026,” after “2021”.
